name: @vetwo/design-tokens
description: Single source of truth for VeTwo website design tokens

contrastNotes.primaryTextOnBackground: Measured ~17.9:1 (AAA pass). Verify with tooling after render.
contrastNotes.secondaryTextOnBackground: Measured ~7.0:1 (AA pass, near AAA boundary). Do not use below 12px.
contrastNotes.accentOnBackground: Accent alone is NOT sufficient for text; pair with primary text or use for large graphics only.
contrastNotes.policy: Never communicate status through color alone; always include icon + text label.

font.monoNote: Roboto Mono via next/font/google (weights 400/500/600); variable --font-roboto-mono. PNU unchanged for Arabic.
font.displayNote: Headings use Inter (font-display role). Audiowide files remain on disk, unreferenced.

weightSources.Inter: next/font/google, weights 400/500/600/700, latin subset, display swap; fetched at build, self-hosted at runtime
weightSources.Roboto Mono: next/font/google, weights 400/500/600, latin subset, display swap; fetched at build, self-hosted at runtime
weightSources.PNU: static files only: Light=300, Regular=400, Medium=500, Bold=700; weight 600 renders as 700 per CSS fallback rules

font.trackingRule: Never apply letter-spacing (tracking-*) to Arabic text; Tailwind tracking utilities are Latin-only.
font.strategy: Self-hosted local @font-face from public/fonts with font-display: swap. Remote fonts and Google Fonts are prohibited.

layout.radiusNote: Restrained Neon-inspired treatment (was 14/22): compact controls, minimal card chrome. Larger radii only where usability requires.
